An index of Universal Composability (UC) ideal functionalities, organized into 9 dependency layers (roughly, each layer builds on the ones before it). Every entry links to its own page; pages are currently stubs — precise definitions, known realizations, and formal artifacts will be filled in over time.

*Status legend:* S = idealized setup · C = canonical · E = emerging · O = open (no UC formulation yet)
